comparison.objective: Swipe a magnetic-stripe card through a reader in one valid pass; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Card grasp, slot alignment and controlled linear speed/orientation versus recessed hex-key insertion, fine collar rotation, counterholding and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: A single correctly oriented, continuous reader pass versus two acceptable physical impact cycles after locking. Candidate dynamic thresholds are incomplete.
comparison.reason: Only generic trajectory control is shared; the tested manipulation and outcome are different.
